# timm helpers

Three unchanged helper files from timm 0.6.12. The plugin loads only `drop_path`, `to_2tuple` and `trunc_normal_` through an isolated adapter; the complete timm package is not installed.

See `LICENSE` for the upstream Apache-2.0 license and `PYTORCH_LICENSE.txt` for the applicable PyTorch-derived portions. Original source comments and notices are preserved. `MANIFEST.json` records relative paths and checksums.
